ctx.x: And the thing was appalling on the others, there's no life there anymore, it was just a job. I will always remember, there was a clarinet player at that time I was working

for at the Liberty Inn who was Johnny Lane. He's still playing that . And Johnny would a nice little potbelly around, Italian but he changed it, just like Frankie Lane from Italiano to Lane. And he's standing there playing the clarinet and here comes this stripper. And he's playing her music.

And at the end of the act she takes her bow. And the fans go out and the rear end sticks back. And here's Johnny with his clarinet almost in her rear end, his eyes pop out and the show was watching Johnny pop his eyes out seeing that big rear end. It's like a drummer once said to me, working at this place, I'm getting so tired of seeing naked women, I appreciate seeing a naked man.
